questions.stem: A mother observed unusual redness on the palms of her young child while putting him to sleep. She brings him to your OPD and on examination, you find mild abdominal distension, splenomegaly, and pedal edema. You admit the child for further evaluation, but on the night of admission, he suddenly starts vomiting fresh blood. Which is the most likely diagnosis?
